Every one of them stamps the lead's source from an ingest row an operator configured: a contract for the first two, an intake form for the third. Arriving is every lead created in the window, counted without a source filter of any kind: a lead is a lead, and narrowing the total to a chosen set of sources hides the rest while looking deliberate. The SOURCE is a split, not a filter: By Source is frappe's own group-by over every lead this site holds, carrying no filter at all, and Which Door accounts for every lead in the window \u2014 contracts and intake forms against everything else \u2014 so its slices add up to the total.
